what_it_is: Low-quality, mass-produced AI-generated content that floods feeds and platforms.
why_this_week: Digiday 1 Oct 2026: Pixability launches Pixie to filter AI slop on YouTube for ad adjacency; Adweek Oct 2026: Red Antler's Fat Earth Studios pitches UGC against AI slop; Digiday 1 Oct 2026 on creators and YouTube removing AI slop accounts.
origin: In-group slang from about 2022 (4chan, Hacker News, YouTube); championed by Simon Willison on his blog, May 2024; 'slop' named 2025 Word of the Year by Merriam-Webster and the American Dialect Society. Earlier meaning: liquid waste or animal feed.
brand_example: Pixability Pixie (Digiday, 1 Oct 2026); Coca-Cola AI holiday ads backlash, Nov 2024.
relevance: AI-generated content is spreading in Turkish and MEA feeds; brand safety and human-made positioning apply directly.
notes: Not a fresh coinage; famous since 2024-2025. Picked.
